summary: Revise at 6.0 (Caiman 7, ship bar 7.5). The signet rethink holds the read. Shown face-300 and hero-300 uncaptioned, a jeweller says 'gecko' because of the splayed, disc-toed limbs seen from above. Since read test 4 the body spots are fewer and spaced out, and the head is blunt. The craft is not at Caiman's level. It reads as clip-art, not a dark-mythology cast. The body is a smooth sausage carrying ten identical ringed domes that look like rivets. The eyes are balls bolted to the sides of the neck, outside the head outline, and their ragged slit pupils read as screw heads (stones.png). The tail is cut off at the face's left edge as a flared, smeared stub. The pebbled ground renders as ragged, stair-stepped cells, and starburst spikes radiate from the face border. Away from the face the ring is bare: the shoulders and shank are plain polish. The palm lamellae are 20 identical plates with jagged drop edges that read as a radiator or zip-tie, so the theme stops at the face. The base is factory 017, the same tonneau Varanus uses on the Reptilia sheet, so the hero silhouette is a near-twin of that tile. Two gates are automatic revises: the template gate failed (4,747,403 bytes against the 3,000,000 painted budget, template_gate_passed false), and ray release at 0.100 and 0.075 mm is not recorded anywhere. A third result is suspect: the export build at 1536x448 reports the same 520,974 triangles as the 768x320 draft, but template-verification counts 1,479,262 at 1536x448.
strengths: The animal reads at 300 px without a caption: four limbs bent at elbow and knee, each ending in a five-toe fan with disc tips, seen from above on a signet face. This is the classic gecko emblem.
The figure fills the 20 x 15 mm tonneau with a balanced composition, and the limbs and toe fans keep at least about 0.8 mm off the face's edge.
The factory's hard wall-to-face angle is kept round the whole face (bare-vs-finished.png).
The body's spot count dropped from a dense bead cover to 10 spaced spots in two rows. Figure-ground separation is better than in read test 4.

The lost-wax geometry gates are clean: watertight, 0 degenerates, 0 self-crossings on the ring and on both made parts (Tokay, Lamellae), empty notes, nothing in the finger hole, Castable, 0 DFM findings, and cold reload identical.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: The gecko and the pebbled ground stop at the face's edge. The shoulders and both side faces of the shank are bare polish (shoulder.png, side.png, hero.png). The palm lamellae sit alone at 270° as a separate, mechanical strip (palm.png, reverse.png). The section's planned tubercle rows on the side faces and granules on the shoulders are missing.

checklist.item: Hide reads as this specific animal at 300 px
checklist.reason: The figure reads as 'gecko' by its toe pads and posture, but the hide does not. The ground is generic pebbling, and the body is smooth with rivet-like ringed domes, not a tokay's tubercle-spotted skin. At 300 px the ground is grey noise.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true, crisp outlines
checklist.reason: The eye-lid grooves and slit pupils are torn, ragged cuts (stones.png). The granule cells have stair-stepped, broken rims. The tail end is a smeared, flared stub at the face's left edge. Starburst spikes radiate from the face border at the top and bottom (face.png). The lamella drops have jagged, combed edges (palm.png).

checklist.item: Stones sit in made settings and are visible
checklist.reason: N/A. Gekko carries no stone: stones.json is empty, and reported 0 equals previewed 0.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms sculpted
checklist.reason: The torso and head are smooth polished blobs with no modelling: no shoulder girdle, ribs, pelvis or skull planes. The ten spots are identical domes in grooved rings, like rivets. The eyes are spheres stuck outside the head outline. The lamellae are 20 identical extruded plates. The limbs are uniform tubes with ball toes, which reads as cartoon, not sculpture.

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps its hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: The 017 tonneau's wall-to-face edge is crisp all round in bare-vs-finished.png and face.png.

checklist.item: Silhouette distinct from other Cataphracta rings and the Reptilia tiles
checklist.reason: Factory 017 is Varanus's base on the Reptilia sheet ('Factory signet 017 · patterned face'). In the hero, the tonneau head and tapering shank are a near-twin of the Varanus tile. Only the relief differs, and nothing breaks the profile.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: The large form (the figure) and the small form (the pebbling) are present, but the medium tier is missing on the body. Most of the ring's surface (shank, shoulders, side faces) is empty. Density is well below Caiman, which is worked on every surface.

gates.verified: draft and export geometry: watertight true, degenerate_faces 0

gates.gate: 0 self-crossings on ring and every made part
gates.verified: self_crossings 0; made_part_crossings Tokay 0, Lamellae 0; sculpt self_crossings 0, open_edges 0
geometry.notes [], parts_joined 2. The sculpt composition note 'relax undone within 0.3 mm of 1 crossings' is informational.
vertices_inside 0, nearest margin 9.4e-8 mm (at the bore surface)

gates.gate: field verdict Castable (ring's own process: LostWax per draft block and Logan's 2026-10-03 rule)
gates.verified: verdict Castable, with_part_verdict Castable, thinnest wall 1.48 mm. The land_widths treatments for the toes (0.019 mm), toe pads (0.007 mm) and eyes (0.002 mm) are accepted by the gate, but the toe treatment admits short-filled tips that need laser tacks.

gates.gate: ray release 0 obstructions / 0 unresolved at 0.100 and 0.075 mm
gates.verified: Not recorded anywhere in report.json (no release block at draft or export).
report.layers is empty, so there is no clamped layer and no bite to report. N/A, but the report should state it explicitly.
cold_reload.identical true (520,974 faces); template-verification vertices_faces_normals_identical true

export 520,974 (report) / 1,479,262 (template-verification at 1536x448). Both are under 2M, but the report's export build has the same triangle count as the 768x320 draft, so it may not be a true 1536x448 build.

gates.gate: template gate: <= 4 design.set patches within class budget
gates.verified: design_set_patches [] (0, OK), but template_bytes 4,747,403 > size_budget_bytes 3,000,000 (class 'painted'); template_gate_passed false; size_review_required true

punch_list.change: Run mf::inspect + mf::release::analyze at sample pitch 0.100 and 0.075 mm on the finished ring with both parts, and record obstructions and unresolved counts in report.json at draft and export. Add an explicit 'clamp bite: none (no clamped layers)' entry. Re-run the export build at true 1536x448 and record its own triangle count.
punch_list.acceptance: report.json has release blocks with obstructions 0 and unresolved 0 at both pitches, at draft and at export. The export triangle count differs from the draft count and matches template-verification's 1536x448 count.

punch_list.change: Bring the template under budget. Decimate the stored Tokay part further (it is 388,894 faces now; target <= 200k with a 0.002 mm tolerance, which should hold the read). Replace the 220,000-face stored 'Lamellae' mesh with the procedural lamella tiling the section specifies (reptile::svg::lamella, graded 0.9 to 1.4 mm), so it stores as an alpha, not a mesh.
punch_list.acceptance: template-verification.json shows template_bytes <= 3,000,000 (or within the class budget the template is re-classed to), design_set_patches <= 4, and template_gate_passed true.

punch_list.zone: Tokay head and eyes (right end of face, about 70-90° of the face's long axis)
punch_list.change: Move the eyes onto the head. Seat each eye on the head's rear-upper corner, half sunk into the skull, 1.6 mm across and 0.6-0.7 mm proud, breaking the head's side outline by about 0.4 mm. Do not leave them as separate balls on the neck. Replace the torn slit with a clean vertical pupil groove (0.25 mm wide, 0.12 mm deep, drafted), and give the lid a smooth 0.2 mm rim. Model the skull: a brow ridge over each eye, a shallow jaw line from snout to eye, and two nostril dots. Broaden the rear of the head to 1.4x the neck.
punch_list.acceptance: In stones.png the eyes are on the head's outline, their pupils and lids have smooth, unbroken edges, and nothing reads as a screw head. In face-300.png the head reads as a big-eyed gecko face.

punch_list.zone: Tokay tail, the face's left edge (about the -x end of the face, where it meets the shoulder)
punch_list.change: Finish the tail on the face. Run it as an S-curve or a curl that tapers from about 70% of the hip width to a 0.8 mm rounded tip, at least 0.8 mm inside the face edge. Alternatively, carry it deliberately over the edge and down the left shoulder as relief, with shallow rings (<= 0.15 mm), ending in a tip on the shank at about 130°. Remove the flared, smeared stub.
punch_list.acceptance: In face.png and hero.png you can follow the tail to a clean tip, and nothing is cut off or smeared at the face's edge.

punch_list.zone: Shoulders and shank side faces (from the face edges to the lamellae, about 110-250° and 290-70°)
punch_list.change: Carry the hide down the shank as the section planned. Put tubercle rows on both side faces (sheared, 0.4 mm high, gated SideFaces(Both)). Run granules over the shoulders' outer crown, grading from the face's pebble size to about half that by 200°/340°. Optionally walk one toe fan or the tail over a shoulder to tie the face to the band.
punch_list.acceptance: In hero.png, side.png and shoulder.png no bare polished area larger than about 3 x 3 mm remains outside the bore, and the texture reads continuously from the face to the lamellae.

punch_list.zone: Tokay torso spots and body form (face centre)
punch_list.change: Replace the ten identical ringed domes with tokay spotting. Use 12-16 low, flat-topped, irregular spots, 0.8-1.6 mm across and 0.15-0.25 mm proud, with no groove ring, varied in size and in two loose rows plus scattered side spots. Sculpt the torso: shoulder and hip swells over the limb roots, a faint spine line, and a slight belly taper to the waist.
punch_list.acceptance: In face.png no spot reads as a rivet or button, and the torso shows shoulder and hip masses. In face-300.png the body is still one clean shape with its spots visible.

punch_list.zone: Pebbled ground and face border (the whole face, and its perimeter at the wall-to-face edge)
punch_list.change: Rebuild the ground so that its cells have clean rims. Use a finer or less jaggy mesh, or a proper alpha with lands >= 0.2 mm, cells 0.6-1.0 mm, and a calm 1.0 mm halo round the figure at half height. Remove the starburst spikes along the face border: stop the ground 0.5 mm inside the edge with a clean step.
punch_list.acceptance: In stones.png and face.png the cell rims are smooth and unbroken, and the border shows no radial spikes. In face-300.png the figure has a quiet halo against the ground.

punch_list.change: Make the lamellae read as gecko toe-pad scansors, not a radiator. Grade the pitch from 0.9 mm at 270° to 1.4 mm at the ends, as specified. Curve each plate's leading edge into a shallow arc, about 0.3 mm of sagitta across the band. Add the split chevron lamella at 270°. Clean the jagged drop edges.
punch_list.acceptance: In palm.png the plates visibly grade in pitch, have smooth crescent edges with no jagged combing, and show the centre chevron.

punch_list.zone: Overall silhouette (the face and shank profile in the hero)
punch_list.change: Distinguish the ring from Varanus's 017 tonneau. Let the relief break the profile, for example toe fans that wrap over the face's edge onto the wall by 1.0-1.5 mm at the four corners, or a tail curling down a shoulder. You could also taper the shank more strongly toward the palm.
punch_list.acceptance: Set beside the Varanus tile at the same angle, the hero-300 outline differs visibly at the face corners or the shoulder.
